description: This file is a Perl script that functions as a static analysis tool for checking patches and source files, specifically tailored for the OpenWrt project. It includes license information, command-line options parsing, file processing routines, and various code checks related to coding style, licensing, and patch management.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Displays help message and usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: list_types
methods.description: Lists all message types defined within the script, used for understanding message categorization.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and stores a style or error report message, with color highlighting if enabled.

methods.name: top_of_openwrt_tree
methods.description: Checks whether the current directory is the root of an OpenWrt source tree.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a given source or patch file, performs syntax and style checking, and outputs warnings/errors.

methods.name: is_maintained_obsolete
methods.description: Determines if a file is marked as obsolete in the MAINTAINERS hierarchy.

methods.name: seed_camelcase_file
methods.description: Adds CamelCase identifiers from a header or source file to the detection cache.

methods.name: seed_camelcase_includes
methods.description: Seeds the cache of CamelCase identifiers by scanning include headers and git history.

methods.name: git_commit_info
methods.description: Retrieves commit info such as hash and message for a given git commit.

methods.name: expand_tabs
methods.description: Converts tab characters in a string to spaces based on the selected tab size.

methods.name: sanitize_line
methods.description: Cleans a line of code by handling comments, quotes, and preprocessor directives for analysis.
